participation.context: Named the penny and the notch, and ate it short.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Measured a full thumb, and refused a second cut.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Told him to leave the dresser out of it.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You took the loaf as it was measured. You did not ask her to cut another.

description: Full enough to find the latch

participation.context: Came in by the moon, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Still unwarned. Not in the house.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

story.body: You named the moon, the seal, the quiet tooth, and Phillips. You did not open the letter, and you did not tell him.

title: Found the latch
